name: CoAuthLocks
remarks: Use the Locks property to return the CoAuthLocks collection.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified CoAuthLocks object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of locks in the CoAuthLocks collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an individual CoAuthLock object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add([Range As Variant], [Type As WdLockType]) As CoAuthLock
methods.description: Returns a CoAuthLock object that represents a lock added to a specified range.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: Specifies the document range locked by the CoAuthLock object. This parameter may be a Paragraph, Column, Cell, Row, Table, Range, or Selection object.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Specifies the type of lock. The WdLockType specified can only be wdLockEphemeral or WdLockReservation

methods.name: RemoveEphemeralLocks
methods.description: Removes ephemeral locks from the document.
